logo_override.validation_detail: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 35469 bytes, served by www.massey.ac.nz (the awarding body's own domain). Root . Artwork is the full Massey University primary logo: shield crest + "MASSEY UNIVERSITY" / "TE KUNENGA KI PUREHUROA" wordmark as vector paths. Fills are Massey Blue #004B8D (crest and wordmark) and Massey Gold #E4A024 (crest detail), plus #9B7023/#D9992F shading and small #FFFFFE interior crest details - i.e. a dark/coloured wordmark on transparency, NOT white-on-transparent.
logo_override._award: Massey University Doctoral Scholarship (also used for target 658 Undergraduate International Study Grants and target 659 Postgraduate International Study Grants)

notes: Searched the awarding body's own markup for a logo. webfetch of https://www.massey.ac.nz/ and of the shard page https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/massey-university-doctoral-scholarship showed the live header/footer logo is plus data-logo-dark-theme / data-logo-light-theme on CloudFront, and og:image / favicons / apple-touch-icon / site.webmanifest all point at d2ub1k1pknil0e.cloudfront.net. CloudFront is a third-party CDN, so all of those were rejected under the third-party-host ban. Also checked brandlibrary.massey.ac.nz (an official Massey subdomain with a 'Massey Logos' album); every asset there, including og:image mu-logo.png and the album covers, is served from cdn-syd.brandkit.com, i.e. Brandkit's CDN, so it was rejected too. Switched to same-origin probing on www.massey.ac.nz: /apple-touch-icon.png, /apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png, /favicon-96x96.png, /site.webmanifest, /media/images/massey-logo-dark.width-600.webp, /static/69b7a4e0/favicon.svg, /static-svg/dist/logo.svg and /static-svg/dist/massey-logo{,-dark}.svg all returned 404. https://www.massey.ac.nz/favicon.ico did return 200 image/vnd.microsoft.icon but is only the small crest mark, so a better candidate was sought. https://www.massey.ac.nz/static-svg/dist/logo-light-theme.svg returned 200 image/svg+xml, 35469 bytes, and its content is the full Massey University primary logo in Massey Blue #004B8D with gold #E4A024 accents - dark on transparent, not a white wordmark. Checked the events.massey.ac.nz sibling first: https://events.massey.ac.nz/static-svg/dist/logo-light-theme.svg is 200 but is a bare sprite with no , so it would render blank in an ; the www.massey.ac.nz variant was chosen because it includes the reference and is on the main awarding host. Grepped the current www CSS/JS bundles: the header logo is now injected from CloudFront, so this SVG is a same-origin build artifact of the site's own static pipeline rather than a third-party file - it is still served with 200 by www.massey.ac.nz and is unambiguously the official logo. Browser re-render check of the SVG timed out, so visual confirmation rests on the fetched source structure (root svg + defs/symbol + use) and the fill attributes. One logo serves all three records on this host.
